title: Cancellation, Refund Form and Penalty Terms across the Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
Tariffs and Distribution schedules, brand by brand across the Air Ticket Fare Brands, what a brand returns on cancellation, how long the settlement takes, and what is withheld.

## Part A — the quantities

- **Refundable.** Whether an unflown ticket can be refunded at all, or only forfeited.
- **Refund form.** The form value is returned in on cancellation: none, a travel credit, or the original form of payment.
- **Refund processing time.** The business days the settlement of an approved refund takes.
- **Void window.** The whole hours after ticket issue in which the ticket may be voided at no cost.
- **Cancellation deadline.** The hours before departure by which a cancellation must be confirmed.
- **Flat cancellation penalty.** The flat penalty withheld from the value returned.
- **No-show penalty.** The penalty charged when the traveller neither flies nor cancels before departure.

| Fare brand | Refundable | Refund form | Processing (business days) | Void window (hours) | Cancellation deadline (hours before departure) | Flat cancellation penalty (USD) | No-show penalty (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Basic Economy Lite | no | none | 0 | 24 | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Economy Saver | no | a travel credit | 14 | 24 | 2 | 149.00 | 225.00 |
| Economy Classic | no | a travel credit | 14 | 24 | 2 | 119.00 | 195.00 |
| Economy Flex | yes | the original form of payment | 10 | 24 | 2 | 89.00 | 150.00 |
| Premium Economy Select | yes | the original form of payment | 10 | 24 | 3 | 79.00 | 125.00 |
| Business Saver | yes | the original form of payment | 7 | 24 | 3 | 59.00 | 100.00 |
| Business Flex | yes | the original form of payment | 5 | 24 | 4 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

The void window is scheduled at 24 hours on all seven brands alike.

## Part B — the cancellation penalty ladder

The ladder states the penalty by how far ahead of the outbound departure the cancellation is confirmed.

| Fare brand | 60 days or more (USD) | 59 to 15 days (USD) | 14 to 3 days (USD) | 2 days or fewer (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Basic Economy Lite | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Economy Saver | 89.00 | 129.00 | 149.00 | 189.00 |
| Economy Classic | 69.00 | 99.00 | 119.00 | 159.00 |
| Economy Flex | 49.00 | 69.00 | 89.00 | 119.00 |
| Premium Economy Select | 39.00 | 59.00 | 79.00 | 99.00 |
| Business Saver | 0.00 | 39.00 | 59.00 | 79.00 |
| Business Flex | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

## Part C — points of judgement

**Which brands the schedule marks as not refundable.** Basic Economy Lite, Economy Saver and Economy Classic. Of those three only the first is scheduled with a refund form of none; the other two are scheduled to return value on a travel credit.

**Where the ladder is silent.** Basic Economy Lite and Business Flex are scheduled at 0.00 USD in every band of the ladder, and both carry a flat penalty of 0.00 USD as well; Business Saver is scheduled at 0.00 USD in the 60-days-or-more band alone.

**Hypothetical comparison.** A hypothetical Economy Classic cancellation confirmed 20 days ahead of departure falls in the 59-to-15-days band, where this schedule states 99.00 USD; the same cancellation confirmed 10 days ahead falls in the 14-to-3-days band, where it states 119.00 USD.
